caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The object is a semi-circular comb, with a rounded, crescent-shaped top and seven straight, evenly spaced teeth extending downward from the flat edge at the bottom center. The comb is colored with various shades of brown, ranging from light tan to darker, wood-like hues, with subtle gradients and texture that give it a somewhat marbled or natural appearance. There are no additional objects or elements present in the composition, and the entire focus remains on the centrally placed comb against the untextured, neutral background.
